tools.name: canoli_begin_connection
tools.title: Connect a Canoli document
tools.description: Create a two-minute, one-use local pairing request. Give the connection code to the user to paste in Canoli’s ChatGPT connection dialog. It shares no document until the user explicitly chooses and authorizes it there.

tools.name: canoli_list_documents
tools.title: List connected Canoli documents
tools.description: List only browser documents the user explicitly connected to this local plugin process. These are live browser documents, separate from headless REST sessions.

tools.name: canoli_read_document
tools.title: Inspect a connected Canoli document
tools.description: Read the current serialized document, revision and undo/redo availability. Layer text and settings may be private. Original image/file bytes and host credentials are not returned.

tools.name: canoli_new_layer_template
tools.title: Prepare a new Canoli layer
tools.description: Return a fresh detached paint, vector, text or group layer from Canoli’s actual OO constructors, without inserting it or changing history. For a new layer, apply its complete returned data with layer.add, then use layer.update or related commands in the same transaction for content/settings. Reading a template grants no write permission and imports no image.

tools.name: canoli_apply_edits
tools.title: Apply reversible Canoli edits
tools.description: Apply 1–256 strict shared Canoli commands as one undo step. First inspect the current revision and read canoli://commands. Only an explicitly writable connection may edit. Existing referenced assets must remain valid; this tool neither fetches images nor evaluates JavaScript. Reuse the idempotency key only for an exact retry.

tools.name: canoli_undo
tools.title: Undo a Canoli edit
tools.description: Move one step in the connected document’s normal shared history, which can include human edits. Inspect the current history and obtain the user’s intent before undoing or redoing their work. Requires editing permission, the current revision and a stable retry key.

tools.name: canoli_redo
tools.title: Redo a Canoli edit
tools.description: Move one step in the connected document’s normal shared history, which can include human edits. Inspect the current history and obtain the user’s intent before undoing or redoing their work. Requires editing permission, the current revision and a stable retry key.

tools.name: canoli_disconnect_document
tools.title: Disconnect a Canoli document
tools.description: Revoke this process’s connection to the chosen live document. Accepted artwork and normal undo history remain in Canoli.

resources.name: canoli-commands
resources.title: Canoli command and field index
resources.description: Compact index of actual command types and layer-update fields. Read only the schemas needed for the intended edit, rather than loading every command. Runtime validation, locks, revisions, source checks and permissions remain authoritative.

resources.name: canoli-all-command-schemas
resources.title: Complete Canoli command schemas
resources.description: Large full-schema reference for advanced cases. Prefer canoli://commands and focused command/field schemas for ordinary edits.

diagnostics.stage: independent final source-lifetime review and five red browser cases
diagnostics.finding: All five held-authorization source removal/replacement/bitmap closure and historical undo/redo tests initially demonstrated unsafe acceptance. Candidate/historical target assets now validate before authorization and pinned sources recheck immediately after it before synchronous publication. Exact rejected receipts stay rejected; restored-source new requests succeed.
Node fetch rewrote the supplied Host test header, so the original assertion did not send an evil Host. A raw Node HTTP request exercises actual wrong-Host rejection; host guard remained unchanged.

Complete generated command schema was 567090 bytes, too large for routine context. Compact 6703-byte actual index and focused 372-byte opacity metadata now preserve exact validators and full optional reference.
Read-only templates come from actual detached OO constructors, allowing strict layer.add plus layer.update in one normal undo step rather than invented parallel DTO defaults.

coverageLimits: SDK/clean package/Chrome workflow proof is not installation or model-driven acceptance in an actual ChatGPT client.
Public desktop-only submission requires OpenAI partner eligibility; no publishing or outreach was performed.
T24 identity sign-in and optional plan usage remain separate and unimplemented by local document pairing.
Tool metadata can include private text/settings/history labels but does not include original source bytes, host credentials, browser storage or arbitrary script/file/network/native preparation.
Metadata transport budgets do not impose original-image geometry/file-size caps.
Synthetic exact 50 MP output does not prove physical photographic quality, peak memory, sustained 60fps or physical-device acceptance.
Independent headless REST sessions and isolated third-party command execution remain separate.
No paid inference, account creation, public service or original-file upload was introduced.
Production dependency audit is clean; existing development-tool advisories are not claimed fixed.
The complete original implementation roadmap objective remains active.
